replies.text:
This reminds me of my best friend, how they used to hug me tightly whenever they made a new, fresh cut on their thighs,along with their wrists. They’d cry and tell me that they just wanted to be loved, and to be seen as the way they were. I never got the chance to tell them that I loved them than they could ever comprehend.

But on 12,25,23. They messaged me after the Christmas celebration had ended on 12 o’clock midnight. Saying that they couldn’t bear it anymore, saying that they were a burden on my shoulders. Then, they texted a final time, saying that I didn’t need to worry about them anymore. 

Three years later, and I’m still visiting their grave. Even when my parents say that I have to let them go. I could never. I loved them too much, I loved her too much, I was her safe space. I will always be her safe space even in death.
